# Environment Dependency for API Access

The AtlassianJiraGateway depends on environment variables to function correctly. If these are not set or misconfigured, it will raise a JiraError and fail to instantiate. This creates a risk in environments where configuration management is not tightly controlled.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/jira.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.jira.AtlassianJiraGateway.__init__`
